items.t: No clear trend in pollution-sensitive animals in this region (+0.0 points per decade; 53 surveys at 28 sites, 2017–2026; q = 1.00).
Chloride: of 3 sites with long records here, 0 are rising and 1 falling (seasonal Kendall per site, false discovery rate 5% across all 396 sites tested).
Paved and roofed area went from 1.5% in 1985 to 2.4% in 2025 across 2,370 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).

233 of 2,370 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life, 68 for salt or chloride; 216 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
9 of 2,370 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 37 of 38 high-need ones have none.
